text.マンションのインフィル（インテリア）が、私のライフワークになったのは15年前のこ: Apartment infill — the interior — became my life's work fifteen years ago. I was living in a newly built apartment block I had helped construct, and in designing the interior of my own flat I realised something: the way new apartments are currently produced cannot deliver a home that genuinely satisfies.
text.それ以来、永く住み継ぐための本物の住まいを追い求め、マンションインフィルに関わり: Since then I have gone on working in apartment infill, pursuing a real home — one that can be lived in and handed on for a long time.
text.建築家やデザイナーなど、プロと言われる人はもちろん、お客様に「このマンションは本: Our watchword is to make people say that this apartment is the real thing — architects and designers and others called professionals, yes, but our clients above all. On that basis we go on proposing homes that can be loved indefinitely.
text.1955年生まれ。日本大学理工学部卒。: Born 1955. Graduated from the College of Science and Technology, Nihon University.
text.大手建設会社に入社後、国内外の現場を指揮。所長、工事部長、建築部長を歴任する。大: He joined a major construction company and ran sites in Japan and abroad, serving in turn as site manager, head of construction and head of building. Through continuous contact with buildings in Japan and abroad designed by large architectural practices and by foreign architects, he came to know what is essential in both Japanese and Western building. He also studied under leading figures in apartment renovation and in additive-free housing, and has advised the management associations of vintage apartment blocks, giving him wide technical knowledge and experience of apartment buildings.
text.2010年10月株式会社タイムレスリビングを設立。: Founded Timeless Living Co., Ltd. in October 2010.

description: Fumio Hirata on fifteen years of apartment infill, and why the way new apartments are currently produced cannot deliver a home that genuinely satisfies.
